title: Best budae-jjigae near Mapo?
body: Just had lunch at Budaeok by Mapo station and it might be the best army stew I've had in Seoul. The broth is unreal. Anywhere else I should try before I fly out on Friday?

comments.body: Try the one in Uijeongbu if you have a spare morning — that's where the dish is from.
Oh nice, I didn't know that. Adding it to the list, thanks!

title: Lantern festival — worth it on a weekday?
body: Heading to Seoul in early November and the Lantern Festival lines up with my dates. Is it insanely crowded, or is a weekday evening manageable?

comments.body: Go right at 5pm when it opens. By 7 the Cheonggyecheon path is shoulder to shoulder even midweek.
